html:
Question 1
?

Given that y>9 and t>0, which of the following is an inhibited decay equation?

a
dydt=−5(y−9)
b
dydt=−5y2(y−9)
c
dydt=−5y(y+9)
d
dydt=−5(y2−9)
e
dydt=−5(9−y)
Submit
